metadata.notes: Honda factbook April 2017, type 2BK-MC51: 62.0 x 41.3 mm, compression 11.5, 28 kW (38 PS) at 12,500 rpm, 23 N·m at 11,000 rpm. Idle 1,400 rpm. Gearbox 3.272/2.187/1.727/1.421/1.222/1.068, primary 2.781, final 2.928. Rear tyre 140/70-17. Intake valve 24.5 mm and exhaust valve 21.0 mm from the same factbook. Cam duration is not published; 255/245 degrees is what puts this model's power peak on 12,500 rpm. valve_cd 1.0 and wall_heat_scale 0.28 correct the small-single flow and heat estimates so the brake output meets the published 28 kW. Redline 14,000 rpm is the reported limiter.
